sam-sales: Quick ask — Prospect Velaris wants a 10m thin-client perf sanity to validate 150 qps sustained (single-turn) with p95 < 220ms. Need run plan + quick hosted vs dedicated cost delta.
irene-eng: We can run today. Clarify model (quant vs base), avg tokens? region? cold-cache ok?
vik-ml: Use redwood/v2-small-q4 primary, v2-medium for comparison. Prompt ~30 tokens in, ~25 tokens out. Do warm and cold (kv off) runs.
sam-sales: Region us-east-2. They prefer cost predictability and want fallback plan to a cheaper model. Also note procurement asked about log retention.
cho-ops: Run plan: 1) 2m warmup @ 15 qps, 2) 1m ramp to 150 qps, 3) 6m sustain 150 qps, 4) 30s microburst @ 350 qps, 5) cool down. Capture p50/p95/p99, batch size histogram, queueing. k6 command: `k6 run --vus 150 --duration 10m --out json=velaris.json k6_thin.js`.
irene-eng: Server: 2xT4s with batching window 30ms, kv-cache enabled, max_batch_tokens 512. Expect p95 ~140-180ms on quantized small. Add one run on v2-medium to show headroom.
vik-ml: Also include a disabled-kv run (worst-case) and a 60s 800 qps microburst to see shedding behavior.
nana-se: Security note for deck: "Smoke runs mask inputs; logs capture RequestID, model_version, timestamp, worker_id. KMS and audit exports available for Private deployments."
sam-sales: Cost ballpark for 1-hour: hosted tokens ~ 150 qps * 25 tokens * 3600s = 13.5M tokens -> ~ $1.10/hr at $0.08 per 1M; dedicated (2xT4 reserved) ~ $9-12/hr total.
irene-eng: I'll kick off tests and post artifacts + per-token latency breakdown by 17:30. No HSM/SSO blockers for this smoke run.
load-bot: load-bot: created loadtest job id=lt-4123459001-1 status=queued
sam-sales: Thanks team — I'll tell Velaris we have a short run scheduled and will follow up with results and the security blurb. :thumbsup:
